#### Zid AI: Smarter Commerce, Faster Growth

In the competitive world of e-commerce, the difference between a window shopper and a loyal customer often lies in two things: **visual appeal** and **persuasive storytelling.** For many merchants, the "content bottleneck"—the endless cycle of taking photos, editing backgrounds, and writing descriptions—is the biggest barrier to scaling. **Zid AI** was designed to shatter that barrier. We’ve trained our models on over **2 million products** to ensure that every output isn't just "content," but a high-converting asset designed to fuel your growth.

### **The Problem: The Content Struggle**

Running a store is hard enough without having to be a professional photographer and a marketing expert at the same time. Most merchants face:

*   **High Production Costs:** Professional shoots and copywriters are expensive.
    
*   **The "Blank Page" Syndrome:** Struggling to write SEO descriptions that actually rank on Google.
    
*   **Inconsistent Branding:** Amateur photos with cluttered backgrounds that make a store look untrustworthy.
    
*   **Time Loss:** Spending hours on a single product listing instead of focusing on sales.
    

### **The Solution: Your All-in-One AI Creative Suite**

**Zid AI** transforms your workflow from a manual grind into a 4-step automated breeze:

1.  **Choose Your Tool** → 2. **Select Your Product** → 3. **Let the AI Work** → 4. **Sync Results Instantly**.
    

### **How Zid AI Empowers Your Business**

#### **1\. AI Product Writer (Words that Sell & Rank)**

Stop guessing what works. Our AI crafts smart, conversion-focused descriptions tailored to your brand.

*   **SEO-Optimized:** Automatically generates titles and tags that help you top search results.
    
*   **Smart Copywriting:** Uses data-driven language to highlight benefits, not just features.
    
*   **Instant Scaling:** Write descriptions for your entire inventory in a fraction of the time.
    

#### **2\. Background Editor (Studio Quality, Zero Effort)**

Clean, professional imagery is the backbone of trust.

*   **Precision Removal:** Effortlessly isolate your product from messy backgrounds with surgical accuracy.
    
*   **Vibrant Aesthetics:** Replace dull backgrounds with professional colors or designs that make your product "pop" off the screen.
    

#### **3\. AI Product Photographer (Professional Shots in One Click)**

You don’t need an expensive studio to get world-class marketing assets.

*   **Lifestyle Transformation:** Turn a basic smartphone photo into a high-end lifestyle shot.
    
*   **Realistic Environments:** Automatically place your products in stunning, realistic settings that help customers visualize them in their own lives.
    

### **The Merchant Advantage**

> **"Zid AI isn't just a tool; it's a team of photographers and writers available 24/7."**

By integrating Zid AI, you are choosing:

*   **Better Conversion Rates:** High-quality visuals and copy lead to higher customer confidence.
    
*   **Lower Overheads:** Save thousands on external agencies and software subscriptions.
    
*   **Market Agility:** Go from a new shipment to a live, optimized listing in minutes, not days.
    

**Ready to let the AI do the heavy lifting?** Explore your new dashboard and see how **Zid AI** makes commerce easier.

featured_apps.name: Bookings
featured_apps.description:
### 📅 Easy & Integrated Booking Management for Zid Stores
Many businesses don't sell physical products for shipping—they sell appointments and bookings: a gym class, a spa session, a salon chair, a daycare slot, and so much more. Yet, these appointments are often managed today via WhatsApp, phone calls, and Excel sheets. This leads to scheduling conflicts, no-show clients, and hours wasted on coordination instead of delivering your service.

💡 Booking App transforms your Zid store into a fully integrated booking platform. Your services are displayed just like products, allowing your clients to choose the date, select the time, and pay—without a single phone call.

### ✨ What Does the App Offer You?
🗓️ Flexible Calendar: Set your business days, service durations, break times, and holidays with ease.

👥 Capacity Control: Full control to accommodate 1-on-1 sessions or group bookings.

💳 Upfront Payments via Zid Pay: Accept full payments or deposits to secure bookings and minimize no-shows.

🔔 Automated Reminders: Confirmation and reminder notifications are sent to your clients prior to their appointment to ensure on-time attendance.

📊 Unified Dashboard: View today’s and this week’s bookings on a single screen, with quick options to edit or cancel in a single click.

🏢 Multi-Resource Organization: Seamless setup whether you manage multiple service providers, rooms, or different branch locations.

⚡ Zero Coding Required: Plug-and-play functionality inside your Zid store right from the moment of activation.

### 🎯 Who Is This App For?
Designed to empower a wide range of service-based businesses, including:

🏋️‍♂️ Fitness Centers & Gyms

💇‍♀️ Salons, Beauty Centers & Spas

👶 Daycares & Educational Centers

🏥 Cosmetic Clinics & Advisory Services

📸 Photography & Event Studios

⚽ Sports Fields & Rental Facilities

🎓 Workshop & Course Providers

💼 Any merchant whose business relies on scheduled appointments.

featured_apps.name: Namaa
featured_apps.description:
AI that learns from every interaction to grow your sales

  **Namaa** works differently from other recommendation apps. Instead of picking products by hand or relying on fixed rules, Namaa reads each shopper's behavior and suggests the right product at the right moment — and it gets better every day without you touching it.

  **🛍️ Try it as a shopper before you install**

  See exactly what your customers will see, inside a real demo store:

  👈 **[Open the demo store](https://xvftpb.zid.store/)**

  Browse products, add something to the cart, and watch the recommendations, bundles, and quantity discounts work in real time.

  **How does the AI work?**

  * Analyzes customer behavior and buying patterns in your store
  * Learns from every click and every purchase
  * Finds which products are genuinely bought together
  * Improves recommendations automatically — the more your store is used, the sharper they get

  And you can point the algorithm at whichever goal matters to you:

  * **Balanced** — the best mix of what fits the shopper and what earns you most
  * **Profit-first** — favors your higher-margin products
  * **Move stock** — pushes slow-moving inventory

  **What you can offer with Namaa**

  **1. Product recommendations**

  Complementary or alternative products shown at the right moment — chosen automatically by the AI, or picked by hand if you'd rather stay in control.

  **2. Gift bundles 🎁**

  "Buy X, get Y free" — and your customer picks their gift step by step right on the prhrough the store or working out the offer's conditions. Namaa reads the discount rulesstraight from Zid, so there's nothing to set up twice.

  **3. Quantity discounts**

  The more they buy, the bigger the discount. You set the tiers you want — 10% off at two units, 15% at three, for example — and Namaa shows them on the product page and applies the discount in the cart automatically.

  **4. Smart coupons**

  A percentage or fixed-amount discount, with extra options:

  * Free shipping
  * Free cash on delivery
  * Minimum order value and a cap on the discount
  * Usage limits per customer or across the whole coupon

  Show it on its own, or alongside product recommendations in the same offer.

  **5. A/B testing**

  Run two versions of the same offer and let the numbers decide which one wins.

  **Smart targeting at every moment**

  Reach your customer anywhere in the store:

  * Add to cart
  * Product page view
  * Cart page view
  * Side cart open

  **It looks like your store**

  * Full control over colors, corners, and button styles
  * Popup or inline, embedded directly in the page
  * Separate settings for mobile and desktop
  * 8 different display positions
  * Custom CSS when you want finer control

  **Know what's actually working**

  An analytics dashboard showing impressions, clicks, orders, and the revenue each offer brought in — in riyals, with no guesswork.

  **Why turn Namaa on?**

  * Your customer sees products that genuinely suit them, not random ones
  * The algorithm runs 24 hours a day and keeps improving
  * No time wasted building rules by hand
  * Every extra riyal in the basket comes from a customer already in your store — with

  **How to activate**

  1. Choose the plan that fits you
  2. Click the activate button
  3. Approve the permissions and install the app
  4. Log in and switch on the AI
  5. The algorithm starts learning and recommending automatically

  Start with a **14-day free trial** — no commitment.
